question: The World Bank extended an unconditional loan of $ ______ million for the SALT project in Andhra Pradesh in October 2022.
solution:
Correct answer is: **250**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• In recognition of the** state government's groundbreaking reform**s, the World Bank has extended an unconditional loan of **$250 million** to **Supporting Andhra's Learning Transformation (SALT) project. **
 
• The** SALT** project's reforms have resulted in a paradigm shift in the way education is delivered, and the results have been encouraging.
 
• The **SALT Project is the World Bank's** first project in the school education sector to be funded without any conditions.
 
• In the last three years, approximately** 53,000 crores** have been spent on school education.
 
• More than** 40,31,239 children **attended government schools during the academic year **2022-2023.**
 
• The lack of facilities or the adoption of English as a medium of instruction in government schools is not the cause of the **decrease in the number of children.**
